Administration Support Officer (Identified) 
  Identified Position - Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander Applicants Only     Location:  Brisbane, QLD   At  MEGT , we're committed to creating meaningful employment opportunities and supporting positive outcomes for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples. We are seeking a motivated and organised  Administration Support Officer  to join our team and provide essential support across a range of business functions.   This is an exciting opportunity to gain valuable experience in a supportive environment while contributing to an organisation that is passionate about making a difference.   
 About the Role 
 As an Administration Support Officer, you will provide administrative support across a variety of departments, including:   
 
 Human Resources 
 Payroll 
 Marketing 
 Finance 
 Front Reception 
 
 Your responsibilities will include:   
 
 Providing professional administrative support to internal teams 
 Welcoming visitors and managing front reception enquiries 
 Assisting with document preparation, filing and record management 
 Supporting payroll, HR, finance and marketing administration 
 Maintaining accurate data and confidential records 
 Providing excellent customer service to internal and external stakeholders 
 Assisting with general office administration and daily operations 
 
 About You 
 To be successful in this role, you will have:   
 
 Strong organisational skills and attention to detail 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 
 A positive attitude and willingness to learn 
 The ability to manage competing priorities 
 Experience using Microsoft Office applications 
 The ability to work both independently and as part of a team 
 
 Mandatory Requirements 
 The successful applicant will be required to obtain or hold:   
 
 Blue Card 
 Yellow Card (NDIS Worker Screening Clearance) 
 National Police History Check 
 
 Why Join MEGT? 
 At MEGT, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We offer:   
 
 A supportive and inclusive workplace culture 
 Opportunities for learning, development and career progression 
 Meaningful work that makes a positive impact in communities 
 A team committed to empowering Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples through employment and education pathways 
 
 Identified Position 
 This is an  Identified Position . In accordance with Section 25 of the  Anti-Discrimination Act 1991 (Qld)  (or the relevant legislation in your state), applicants must identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.   
 Equal Opportunity Employer 
 MEGT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported and empowered to succeed. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and are dedicated to providing a culturally safe and welcoming environment for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples.    If you're looking to build your administration career while making a meaningful contribution to your community, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!

 What You'll Need to Succeed

 A proactive attitude and willingness to work collaboratively 
 Intermediate Microsoft Office skills

 What You'll Get in Return

 Flexible part-time hours

 Attractive salary package 
 Modern waterfront offices

 What You Need to Do Now
